answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with a non-refundable identity bond, slashed rather than locked when an agent's attestations contradict the majority. A newcomer stands on a narrow ledge: to vote or be paid it must post collateral, and each endorsement is escrowed until peers confirm it. Trust accrues in audited steps, never per key. Ten thousand fakes then mean ten thousand forfeited bonds, so a forger's false nebula of puppets burns capital faster than it earns. Honest agents collect steady yield, like grazing a shared meadow; mass identity is cheap to claim, ruinous to redeem.
